svg.text: tie vfbp / vfbn to voutp / voutn
sg13cmos5l_IOPadSingle2Diff: single-ended pad in, differential out, outp - vcm = vcm - outn = pad - vref
Custom padframe cell. Everything runs on the ring rails iovdd / iovss; the 1.2 V core ring vdd is not connected inside the cell; vss joins iovss through the p-substrate (Rsub).
xa = s2d_mpdda_pd, the matched-pair DDA input buffer (gain 2, vfbp / vfbn tied to outp / outn); xt = bias_tree_noab_pd. Netlist reference: ../../netlist/source/sg13cmos5l_IOPadSingle2Diff.spice
Backannotated 2026-11-04 to the drawn cell (C3, layout/klayout, reference netlist pad_candidate.cdl): the cell holds xa + xt + xp as drawn; en_ctrl_3v3 (en_3v3, en_3v3_b)
and bias_gen_pd (iref) sit next to it (slot, top level, CACE templates). No secondary protection: the buffer's vin is the pad. Primary protection xp = s2d_pad_esd, as drawn.
xp = s2d_pad_esd: clamps MCP / MCN with their rppd gate ties RP / RN (bodies on iovss),
diodes DP1 / DP2 (pad -> iovdd), DN1 / DN2 (iovss -> pad), 1.26u x 27.78u each
Rsub: vss and iovss share the p-substrate (as sg13cmos5l_IOPadDiff2Single,
Christoph 2026-11-03: 2(a)). The layout has no top vss text, so LVS
(--disable_tap_extraction) and magic see one net. Simulation: 1 Ohm, a stand-in
for the substrate path. LVS netlists (lvs_ignore=1): left out (open). A SPICE subckt
cannot join two ports, and xschem refuses to short two port nets (Error 10).
